items.title: Trump announces a Greenland deal and X digs up the 1951 one
items.summary: Trump said a deal with Denmark and Greenland gives the US "permanent control" over Greenland's security. X pointed out a 1951 agreement already lets the US run bases there, and Katie Miller's flag-covered map drew criticism.
items.author: @realDonaldTrump

post.name: Donald J. Trump
